attributes.context: This provision appears in Article Seven, titled “Rights of Management,” and follows 7.1, which assigns certain Company functions to sole discretion except as restricted by the agreement.

extraction_text: 7.2. The type of product manufactured, the location of plants, the planning and scheduling of production, the scheduling of work hours, the establishment of labor standards and the introduction of new production methods and new or improved machinery shall be the exclusive function of management.
